verdict.rationale: The docs say "Grok supports any custom model" added through `~/.grok/config.toml`, which suggests you can point a session at a non-xAI model. Beyond that one line, nothing shows how multi-provider selection actually works. Community forks advertising "multi-provider CLIs" hint that upstream support is limited, but that is not a concrete counter-example, so it lowers confidence rather than making this disputed. Missing for 10: a documented list of supported providers or API formats, an in-session model picker or `/model`-style switching, config examples for third-party providers, and independent hands-on confirmation that non-xAI models work.
